media.alt: A 19 second vertical video walking through the empty Fore Motion Golf space in Orange Park, a long carpeted room with the old service counters along one side. The Fore Motion Golf logo sits at the top and a deep green band at the bottom carries the lines Compete. Leagues. Four bays. Events. First access. with foremotiongolf.com. It ends on a deep green card: Join the Founders List, early access to launch events and leagues, foremotiongolf.com.

A man in a mint green polo walks down a long, empty carpeted room past old service counters, with the Fore Motion Golf logo at the top and a deep green band below that reads Compete. Leagues and events at Fore Motion Golf, and foremotiongolf.com.
